artworks.title: Ulrich Grundherr
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of an older man facing slightly to the right and looking forward. The man has a mustache, beard, and a bald head. He wears a large ruff around his neck, a velvety garment with intricate patterns and fur trim on the shoulders. A chain with a medallion hangs on his chest. In his right hand, he holds gloves, and in his left hand, he grips the hilt of a sword. The background features architectural elements like columns. The portrait is surrounded by decorative borders with heraldic shields and Latin text above and below the image, all framed in an ornate style typical of the period.

artworks.title: Jan Gruter
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait depicting a man facing slightly to his right with distinct facial features, a short beard, and combed-back hair. He is wearing a high-collared shirt under a buttoned coat. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with inscriptions. The background has intricate lines, and there is text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Jan Gruter
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man shown from the waist up, seated with his body turned slightly to his left but his face turned towards the viewer. He has a prominent mustache and sharp facial features, with an attentive expression. His hair is short and neatly styled. He is wearing a collared garment with a buttoned vest underneath. There are no visible pieces of jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. The portrait is encircled by an elaborate oval border featuring text, set against a lined background. Below the portrait, there is an inscription with additional decoration, likely in Latin, using an ornate font.

artworks.title: Jan Gruter
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man focusing on his head and shoulders. He is facing slightly to the right, with his facial features including a nose, eyes, mustache, and beard. The man's hair is combed back, and he wears a garment with a large ruff collar typical of late Renaissance fashion and a dark doublet with buttons. The background features an oval frame with an inscription and finely detailed parallel lines.

artworks.title: Jan Gruter, Writer, Critic and Scholar
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of the upper body of a man. He is facing slightly to his right, with a three-quarter profile of his face visible. The man has a beard, mustache, and closely cropped hair. He wears a high-ruffled collar, a doublet with visible buttons with no visible accessories. The man is framed within an oval with Latin text surrounding it, set against a lined backdrop.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man With Cross Around Neck
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, depicted from the waist up. He has defined facial features, including a moustache and neat short hair. He wears a formal attire consisting of a fur-trimmed cloak, a decorated doublet, and a large ruffled collar. He wears a chain with a detailed cross pendant around his neck and appears to be holding or gesturing towards it with his left hand. The background features ornate architectural elements and decorative shields with crests, as well as a larger coat of arms.

artworks.title: Henri Du Plessis
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body at a slight angle, facing left. He has curly shoulder-length hair, a prominent nose, high cheekbones, and a hint of a mustache. He wears a period garment with a large white collar and a ribbon or sash across his chest. The garment is richly textured with an elaborate pattern, and he has a star-shaped insignia on his left shoulder. The background consists of concentric oval lines, framing the figure.

artworks.title: Figures in Gunpowder Plot
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved group portrait of several men from the waist up. The men have distinct facial features, wear hats with feathers or trim, and have long or curly hair. They are dressed in elaborate clothing with ruffled collars and embroidered patterns typical of the time period. Some men appear to be holding scrolls or papers. The background is empty, and the names of the individuals - Robert Winter, Christopher Wright, John Wright, Thomas Percy, Guido Fawkes, Robert Catesby, and Thomas Winter - are written above their heads. The engraving includes a publication note at the bottom stating "Publ. Octr 1. 1794 by Herbert & Crabbold London."

artworks.title: Gunpowder Plot Conspirators
artworks.description: The image shows a group of nine men standing closely together in conversation. Each man has distinct facial features, wearing broad-brimmed hats adorned with feathers and patterned bands. They are depicted from the waist up, with richly detailed clothing, including ruffled collars, embroidered sleeves, and capes or coats with elaborate designs. Some men gesture while one holds a paper and another has a sword hilt visible. The background is plain, focusing on the men and accompanying text below them.

artworks.title: Execution of the Gunpowder Conspirators
artworks.description: This is an illustration of an execution scene during the Gunpowder Plot trials in the Year 1606. The image shows a 17th-century town square bustling with activity, including horses, onlookers, and officials overseeing the event. In the center, there is a place of execution with gallows and smoke rising from the ground. Surrounding the scene are buildings with detailed architectural features, and crowds of people observing from windows and balconies. The drawing is done in a style typical of engravings from the period, offering a historical and dramatic visual narrative.

artworks.title: Ludovick Guntherus of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows a person riding a horse. The person is seated on the horse with their body turned slightly to the left. Their facial features show a mustache and a goatee, and their hair is styled in a voluminous manner. They are wearing ornate armor, with detailing around the chest, arms, and legs. A ruffled collar is present around their neck. Their right hand holds a baton or a staff, while the left hand grips the reins of the horse. The horse has a flowing mane and raised front legs. The background features a small fortified castle or settlement on an island, with hills and water in the background. Above the person, in the top left corner, there is a heraldic crest.

artworks.title: Gustavus Adolphus
artworks.description: The image depicts a small oval portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He is facing slightly to the right with a engaged posture. His features include a prominent forehead, a pointed nose, and facial hair. He has neatly styled, slightly wavy dark hair, and is wearing formal historical clothing with a high ruffled collar. The background is plain with subtle texture and natural age-related markings, with handwritten notes and an engraver's signature below the portrait.

artworks.title: Gustavus Adolphus
artworks.description: The image is an engraving portraying a man from the waist up, facing the viewer's left in a three-quarter profile. He wears a high-collared garment with intricate lace, overlaid armor with ornate neck adornments. The man has a mustache, beard, and styled hair with a widow's peak. The armor texture and lace are detailed. The oval-framed portrait has inscriptions around it. Below, text and heraldic symbols suggest a royal or noble status. There are no visible jewelry or objects, but the regalia and expression convey significance. The background has fine cross-hatching typical of engravings, adding depth.

artworks.title: Eleanor Gwyn, Mistress of Charles II
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, seated with a relaxed posture. She has an oval face with distinct features, including arched eyebrows, a small mouth, and curly hair with pearls. She wears a draped fabric, exposing her shoulders. The background is soft and monochromatic, featuring the name "Eleanor Gwyn" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Mary, Wife of Thomas Habingdon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She is standing or depicted in an upright position, with both hands delicately clasped at her waist. Her facial features include a composed expression, with her hair styled neatly back and covered with a small bonnet or cap. She is wearing an elegant, high-collared dress adorned with intricate patterns, lace, and a fur trim around her shoulders. The dress features a series of decorative buttons down the front and finely detailed sleeves. The woman is also wearing a pendant on a chain that hangs from her neck. The background is plain, with no additional visual elements besides a small, elaborate script below the portrait containing her name and historical context.

artworks.title: Mary, Wife of Thomas Habingdon
artworks.description: The image shows two engraved portraits, one above the other. The top portrait is of Thomas Habingdon Esq., and the bottom portrait is of his wife, Mary Habingdon. Thomas is depicted facing forward with his shoulders slightly turned, wearing an elaborate high-ruffed collar and striped jacket. Mary is shown in a similar pose with her hands at chest level, wearing a detailed ruff, a decorated bodice, and sleeves. Both have plain backgrounds, and descriptive text about each person is placed under their image.

artworks.title: Charles Montagu, First Earl of Halifax
artworks.artist: John Smith after Sir Godfrey Kneller
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing a three-quarter view of the subject's body, from the waist up. The person is standing with one arm bent and resting on their hip, while the other arm is extended slightly outwards. The individual has curly, shoulder-length hair, which frames their face. Their facial features include a composed expression with slightly parted lips and eyes looking directly at the viewer. The person's attire consists of an elaborate garment with a high-collared shirt featuring a cravat-type neckpiece, and a jacket adorned with decorative buttons. A cape or cloak drapes over their shoulder. The background features a natural setting with leafy trees and a slightly blurred forest scene.

artworks.title: Rev. Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed portrait of a man in ecclesiastical clothing. He is facing forward, holding a book in his right hand. The man has a long beard and mustache, with combed back hair under a skullcap. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with inscriptions. The frame is adorned with intricate designs, including cherubs, scrolls, a coat of arms, scientific instruments, books, and laurel leaves. The background features detailed linework on a carved stone or wood panel.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image portrays a man shown from the waist up. He has a long face with a well-defined, pointed beard and mustache. His straight hair is visible under a close-fitted cap. The man wears ornate clothing, including an intricate lace collar over a dark robe with embroidered details. He holds a book in his left hand. The image frame is ornate, with scrolls and text as decoration against a dark, textured background with Latin phrases and ecclesiastical motifs.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man seated facing forward within an oval frame. He has distinct facial features with a long beard and mustache, and is dressed in clergy attire. The man holds a small book in his right hand. The background is adorned with decorative motifs including cherubs and a coat of arms. The frame is inscribed with text.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image shows a middle-aged man with a pointed beard, mustache, and styled hair. He has a serious expression and wears ecclesiastical attire with a ruff around his neck, lace cuffs, and a vestment over his shoulders. He holds a small book and the portrait is in an ornate oval frame with decorative patterns. Cherubs are depicted at the top corners of the frame. The background has fine lines, and the frame is inscribed with the words 'Iosephi Hall Norvic' and 'Vera Effigies Reverendio'.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.artist: Paul de Zetter after John Payne
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man seated with his body turned slightly to the side, but his face directed towards the viewer. The man has a long face and a prominent nose, featuring a beard that is pointed and styled downward. His hair is mostly covered by a cap, suggesting it is short. He is wearing a high-collared top with a wide, pleated ruff collar that extends outward. His clothing appears to be formal, with a richly ornamented garment featuring embroidery at the chest area. He holds a book in one hand close to his chest, and on the chest, there is a prominent medallion hanging from a ribbon. The background is ornate, set within an oval frame, with decorative elements including floral motifs and scrolls surrounding the portrait. The name "IOSEPHVS" and "EXONIENSIS" appear on the border of the oval frame. Various architectural and geometric designs also adorn the surrounding border and lower portion of the frame.

artworks.title: Christopher Harant
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing a man's upper body turned slightly to his right, with his head facing the viewer. He has defined facial features, short curly hair, and a confident expression. He is wearing a high ruffled collar and a suit of armor with chainmail on his arms. The background features detailed line work creating a halo effect. An inscription in Latin names the individual and his titles.

artworks.title: William Van Haren
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left while facing forward, featuring a long wavy hairstyle and distinguished facial features. He wears an elegant garment with a richly decorated, patterned collar and a large, elaborately designed cravat or neck cloth. The man is depicted within an oval frame decorated with intricate leaf motifs and linear design elements. Below the image, there is a coat of arms with a shield, crown, and Latin inscription. The background displays classical ornamental designs typical of the period.
